summary: Markets show a risk-off tilt: higher oil prices and a firmer dollar are weighing on bitcoin, gold, and technology shares, while geopolitical supply concerns support crude oil. The available reporting does not verify fresh same-day calls from the named crypto analysts, so new-token signals are limited and should be treated cautiously.[1][2][4]
